attackers_goals: Use a compromised user account that has not been used in a long time and therefore less likely to be noticed.
description: A dormant user account tried to authenticate to a service using a TGS after having been unused for a year or more. This may indicate the account is misused by an attacker.
investigative_actions: See whether the service authentication was successful. Confirm that the activity is benign (e.g. the user returned from a long leave of absence). Check whether you have issues with your Cloud Identity Engine failing to sync data from Active Directory.
name: Authentication Attempt From a Dormant Account
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall traffic Logs

variations.name: Authentication Attempt From a Dormant Account to a sensitive server
variations.description: A dormant user account tried to authenticate to a service using a TGS after having been unused for a year or more. This may indicate the account is misused by an attacker on a sensitive server.
variations.attackers_goals: Use a compromised user account that has not been used in a long time and therefore less likely to be noticed.
variations.investigative_actions: See whether the service authentication was successful. Confirm that the activity is benign (e.g. the user returned from a long leave of absence). Check whether you have issues with your Cloud Identity Engine failing to sync data from Active Directory.
